findings.issue: The AC#4 e2e catches filtered G-2 hands on the filter-change path, because each non-All combination expects the all-hands target and a filtered-only view would have no target line. It does not catch them on App's onGroupingChange path. Group by is changed only once, while the filter is All/All, so filterTrendData(data, filter) === data there.
findings.evidence: src/ui/App.tsx:403-408 onGroupingChange calls filteredStatisticsView(loaded.data, loaded.filter, grouping). Changing it to statisticsView(filterTrendData(loaded.data, loaded.filter), filterTrendData(loaded.data, loaded.filter), grouping) would still pass the e2e, since loaded.filter is ALL_TRENDS when Group by is selected at line 86. The spec's SPEC-05 steps do not ask for this, so the rubric line passes.
findings.fix: After the 12-combination loop, while the filter is still Full ring / Sit-and-go, set Group by to Every 500 hands and then back to Session. Then assert the aria-label still ends with the expected target and there is one line.stats-target.

findings.issue: The sentence about the opt-in speed check's visibility timer sits in the e2e/statistics-hardening.spec.ts bullet. That reads as if the hardening spec contains the speed check, but it is in e2e/statistics-speed.spec.ts.
findings.evidence: Lines 222-226: '- `e2e/statistics-hardening.spec.ts` (TASK-11.13): ... The opt-in speed check stops its timer when the 6th point is visible ...'
findings.fix: Move that sentence into its own bullet that names `e2e/statistics-speed.spec.ts` (opt-in, TLH_SLOW_TESTS=1).

findings.issue: relock_pending now lists tests/stats/trend-grouping.acceptance.test.tsx twice. The TASK-7.18 unlock was never relocked, and this unlock appended a second entry.
findings.fix: De-duplicate the entry when relocking, and relock the file at finalization.

summary: All 12 SPEC items are implemented as specified, and no rubric line fails. Locked file trend-grouping.acceptance.test.tsx: the diff is exactly the pinTimeZone import, one top-level call and blank lines, with no assertion touched. The App stats-state split keeps Statistics behaviour the same. Loading/failed states have no data and get no handlers, but StatisticsScreen renders the selects only when view is truthy, so nothing visible changes. Loaded state recomputes through filteredStatisticsView with the same arguments as before, the read-cancel path is unchanged and all data guards are gone. The AC#4 e2e would fail if App passed filtered hands as the G-2 source on the initial view or on filter change. It would not fail on the grouping-change path (MINOR). The AC#5 e2e would fail with the old `as` casts, because the select would keep 'bogus' and the totals would differ. TZ=UTC vitest over tests/stats plus screen-list: 99 passed. statistics-hardening e2e: 4/4 passed in Chromium and WebKit. Grep checks for SPEC-03, SPEC-09 and SPEC-10 are clean. No changes under engine, bots, advice, storage, vite.config or package.json.
